name: The Grizzled Den
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
narrative.objectives: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah yes, these manes will work great! You show a lot of grit, Champion - I wager we'll see great things from you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hey, adventurer. Been to the Grizzled Den yet? Those Wendigos can be fierce.
